notifications.title: Set one end screen on each long video
notifications.detail: Guides rate a single, specific next video as the best ending for session watch time. End screens can only be set in YouTube Studio, at upload.
notifications.fix: 1. When uploading a long video, open Editor → End screen. 2. Add one 'Video' element pointing to our closest long video in subject (e.g. 'The 6 levels of money in India' for any rich-vs-poor or which-one-are-you video). 3. Add the Subscribe element. Nothing else.

notifications.title: Scout is asked to update thumbnail examples but isn't allowed to write that file
notifications.detail: agents/scout.md (since 2026-10-29) tells Scout to add the week's fastest-growing explainers to improvement/research/thumbnails.json every Monday, but scripts/guard.py only lets Scout write improvement/longform/*, so that edit would block the merge. This week's candidates are in backlog item 2026-11-02-thumb-examples-weekly for research or the improver to add.
notifications.fix: Either 1. in scripts/guard.py add "improvement/research/thumbnails.json" to the "scout" allow-list, or 2. in agents/scout.md move the Monday thumbnail-examples step to the research agent. Only you can change either file.
